title: GPT versus Humans – Uncovering Ethical Concerns in Conversational Generative AI-empowered Multi-Robot Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of ethical concerns generated and deliberated upon during human expert workshops and simulated GPT-agent discussions regarding multi-robot systems.
Qualitative thematic analysis of brainstormed scenarios to identify unfair competition, strategic manipulation, and the withholding of information from competing robot brands.

Thematic analysis of workshop transcripts identifying concerns around linguistic dominance, non-use of natural language ('silent talk' excluding humans), and the lack of cultural sensitivity in LLM-empowered multi-robot communication.
